name: You
storyline:
On an island ravaged by a forgotten war, play as the reincarnation of one of the cursed brothers. Fight, explore, and choose your destiny in a narrative RPG where every decision matters.

You are Lucian, a young recruit. When a civil war begins, you must forge your path and uncover the truth about who you really are—and who you may become.
summary: YOU is a story-rich open-world RPG set on a mystical island shattered by an ancient conflict between two brothers—one who served the gods through sacrifice, the other who resisted. After their fall, the island lies in ruins.
